desc:
Welcome to Midnight Station⛽
LIKE 👍 + FAVORITE ⭐ for a FREE toy gun in-game 🔫

On your way to your job at the local gas station, you decide to turn on the radio to calm your nerves... but instead the radio warns you about a creep that has been spotted around the city.
Will you be able to survive while he is on the loose?

There is 3 endings in this game, try to get them all!
🤝 This game is multiplayer and can be played by up to 4 players at once! This game may be slightly difficult to new players, playing with friends or other people is recommended.

🛒 Check out the shop for fun items to troll your friends with Complete the game 2x for a FREE gamepass item 🎁
